description: List the games (Titles) this connection may work with: TitleID, name, publication status and the permissions granted on each — call it first when the user names a game or says "my game", then pass its TitleID as title_id to the other tools. A game's sandbox copy is a separate Title (DevTitleID) with its own permissions (DevAccess); an empty Access means the live game itself is not granted. Filter by name or id with "search"; long lists are paged (skip/limit, HasMore). Read-only; takes no title_id.

search.description: Optional substring of the game's name or TitleID.

skip.description: How many games to skip (paging). Default 0.

name: list_my_titles
title: List my games
